cli.usage:
Project Notes CLI

Usage: node bin/notes.mjs <command> [options]

Commands:
  projects                       List available projects, including inbox
  list [--project <ref>] [--kind task|prompt|idea] [--status todo|doing|done] [--all] [--trash] [--limit N]
                                 List notes; excludes completed tasks and trash by default. --all includes completed tasks
  add --title <title> [--project <ref>] [--kind task|prompt|idea] [--body <text> | --body-file <path|->]
      [--status todo|doing|done] [--high] [--pinned] [--request-id <id>]
                                 Add a note; without --project, use the current directory or PASEO_AGENT_CWD
  show <itemId> [--history]       Show a note in full; --history separately loads its last 10 snapshots
  update <itemId> [--title] [--body|--body-file] [--kind] [--status] [--high|--normal] [--pinned|--no-pinned]
  done <itemId>                   Mark a task as done
  delete <itemId> / restore <itemId>
                                 Move to or restore from trash

Common: --json for machine-readable output; --project accepts inbox, a prj_... ID, absolute path, or project name.
Body limit: 32000 characters. --body-file reads regular files; - reads standard input. Both are limited to 96000 bytes. Times use UTC.
Data directory: $PASEO_HOME/plugin-data/project-notes/boards (the same files as the plugin UI).

Examples:
  node bin/notes.mjs add --project inbox --title "Task to organize" --body-file - <<'EOF'
  ...multiline design notes...
  EOF
  node bin/notes.mjs list --project inbox --kind task
  node bin/notes.mjs done 3f1c…
